caption.text:
Sometimes the hardest truth to accept is that not everyone is meant to recognize the depth of your heart. You can love deeply, show up fully, and still be met with someone who simply isn’t capable of holding what you offer. That doesn’t mean your love was too much — it means it was meant for someone else. 

Rejection often feels personal, but sometimes it is simply redirection. A quiet protection guiding you away from the places where your heart would have gone unseen, unheard, or unappreciated. Not every closed door is a loss. Some are mercy. 

The right love will not make you question your worth. It will meet your depth with depth, your softness with care, and your devotion with the same steady intention. The kind of love meant for you will recognize your heart immediately — and hold it with gentleness. 🖤

If this spoke to you read more in the book ‘Let Go, Trust God’ by Rebecca Simon 📖
